news.title: Lokesh Machines Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 362.416915 million in funding from RLP Securities Pvt Ltd.
news.body: Lokesh Machines Limited announced a private placement to issue 1,300,000 equity shares at a price of INR 181.71 per share for aggregate proceeds of INR 236,223,000 and 2,777,919 warrants convertible into equity shares at an issue price of INR 45.4275 for aggregate proceeds of INR 126,193,915.3725, total gross proceeds amounting to of INR 362,416,915.3725 on March 6, 2026. The transaction has been approved by the board of directors and will include participation from Kish15ore Babu Bollineni , Mullapudi Sri Krishna, RLP Securities Pvt LTD and others.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.31 (vs ₹2.14 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.31 (up from ₹2.14 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹508.9m (down 1.7% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹6.26m (up ₹47.3m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.2% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 53% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 15% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.4% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent.
